entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level states across users, sessions, and agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system—Abstract, Overview, and Details—to achieve a 91% token reduction and significant task-completion gains on the LoCoMo10 benchmark.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform enables persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from text, code, and conversations. It supports local extraction and embedding models without requiring LLM API keys, distilling session data into durable, searchable permanent memory.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine sustains sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month using a custom vector graph engine. It features byte-level deduplication with a 100% prompt-cache discount and supports multi-modal extraction from PDFs, images, and videos.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain stores explicit facts with provenance across multiple connected agents to provide cited answers and gap analysis. It is deployable locally or remotely via MCP and Bun to serve as a synthesis layer for agent knowledge.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows across more than 25 LLM providers and multiple storage backends. It achieved state-of-the-art performance on the LongMemEval benchmark and offers clients for Python, Node.js, Go, and the CLI.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library implemented as a FastAPI server that serves as the upstream foundation for Hermes-compatible self-hosted wrappers. It supports managed, local CLI, or Docker deployments and integrates with MCP and Cursor-compatible clients.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages context as a git-like repository, offering version control features such as branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, ensuring sub-100ms response times.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance for Hermes Agents. It includes episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth and supports integrations with MCP and OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts during recall.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that provides filesystem-first artifacts like traces, playbooks, and context bundles. It supports Python and TypeScript surfaces and integrates with MCP clients and self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no message is lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for recovering specific details from persistent message histories.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from 34 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups and cross-agent recall via MCP. It allows users to search months of past sessions while stripping keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for private cross-session memory that supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM or local inference server. It includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis to facilitate deployment.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur stores memory as plain-text YAML engrams on local disk to provide a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems. It utilizes hybrid retrieval through BM25 and local embeddings, offering MCP server integration for tool portability.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI is a local-first identity and memory layer that syncs state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other clients. It supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub, achieving a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy in benchmarks.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, including BM25 and vector search, and integrates via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. The project includes a five-package plugin family featuring an SDK, CLI, and a dedicated Hermes adapter.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin features contradiction tracking and explainable recall by tagging every result with a why_retrieved marker. It includes a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps and supports recency ranking and canonicalization.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI maintains agent-driven wikis with citations and provenance, using SQLite for storage with rebuildable Markdown projections. It enables agents to autonomously recall and evolve source-grounded knowledge across sessions using portable archives.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements an anticipatory cache that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It utilizes local-first storage with SQLite-vec and GGUF models, providing an MCP-native server with automated configuration.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide purpose-built evidence packets for agent queries.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to ensure agents load only necessary context, reportedly reducing prompt tokens by 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search, BM25 full-text retrieval, and ranked graph traversal to manage agent knowledge. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to establish navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords from tool schemas. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard for monitoring estimated schema token savings.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It facilitates source-neutral migrations for chat and document exports to maintain reviewed context updates.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It employs BM25 keyword search and importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority entries during context prefetching.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model with an on-demand summarizer and supports immediate event deletion. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and handle x402 payments using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chains. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing APIs to charge for access directly.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and MCP configurations to provide tools for knowledge search and neighbor traversal. It supports automatic tool-OKF generation via detached model calls to streamline local capability routing.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-agent continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected instances. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for session snapshots and a local SQLite layer to ensure write outbox reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and searching. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize retrieval performance.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through a required local SourceVault server for indexing. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, featuring MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It maintains agent continuity by performing automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This kit implements a file-based memory hygiene loop that uses a git-backed directory for versioned, diffable markdown storage without a database. It features dedicated 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, providing evidence-cited diffs through five specific slash commands.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning by applying TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles to agentic software development. It integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools to provide a structured methodology for building software.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to generate web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts through a coding-agent CLI. It supports exports to formats including HTML, PDF, and MP4 while utilizing the DeepSeek Harness for native runtime support.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agent operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool allows agents to convert codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language. It includes a CLI and MCP server that support incremental synchronization while preserving manual layout adjustments.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It functions as a master router that adds verification, escrow, and dispute resolution to official protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content through a two-pass editing process to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns. It offers five voice profiles and three operational modes, including rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos to allow skills to evolve collectively. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and integrates with Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within a project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,170 markdown-based skills for professional and personal tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The skills operate without telemetry or mandatory accounts and offer ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, extract transcripts, and browse channels or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, managed via dedicated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI with remote registry compatibility via Git and S3. It enables secure operations through sandboxed script execution and tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating .lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically synchronizes source edits back into the primary documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Designed to transform rough concepts into structured design documents, this workflow includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models. It offers Lite and Full modes to accommodate varying levels of project complexity during implementation handoffs.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Running on Bun without background services, this harness utilizes the SLP v2 protocol for supervised cooperative-agent teams. It manages decisions and evidence through a CLI-driven mechanism kernel to support long-running agent tasks.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides agentskills.io-compatible skills and guides for VPS production, backups, and cron automation in Portuguese. It supports broad communication integrations including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this toolkit enables interactions with CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams. It is designed for installation via the Vercel CLI to facilitate oracle network and smart contract operations.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation, including BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. It offers specific prompting guidelines to optimize output for the FLUX 3 video suite.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills with line-specific instruction linking. It features automated workflows for the entire lifecycle of briefing, creating, testing, and exporting skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that uses four core verbs—infer, invoke, exec, and agent—to define AI intent as code. It maintains local traces and verification journals for every run and is distributable via shell, Homebrew, npm, or Nix.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client and CLI, alongside commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Focused on autonomous execution, this skill manages complex multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking and decision logging. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for task recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and features a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token consumption and maintains functionality through graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project facilitates agent-driven scheduling and habit management via MCP connections. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial analysis and edge-case hunting. It combines deterministic pre-scans from tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across multiple interfaces including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, supporting 97 different languages. It is designed to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite while evaluating prompt quality across five dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs a swarm of three sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports five major programming languages and includes a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition, utilizing mandatory evidence-based verification gates and a systematic investigation protocol. It includes a Python-based goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors during debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and provides automatic registration for common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 different frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real exploits spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This suite adds session management and worktree recovery tools to provide memory and state drift detection between agent conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding for developing new skills.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy while offering optional incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts and optimized GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It handles the entire pipeline of rendering, compression to under 8 MB, and markdown embedding to enhance project documentation.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables users to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills directly from the terminal or an AI agent. It provides direct installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates seamlessly with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language and validates them against runtime-specific profiles using CI-friendly exit codes. It prevents technical debt by monitoring official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect and report any schema drift.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It ensures reliability by gating all updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators while operating entirely locally.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos into structured Markdown, performing OCR via macOS Vision, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It is designed to streamline content creation and data extraction for e-commerce and document processing workflows.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project enables Hermes Agent to navigate complex Windows environments by routing file operations through environment-specific path syntax. it also automates the selection and verification of project-compatible Python interpreters across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This suite provides agents with skills for social data enrichment, CRM management, and lead generation across platforms like Claude Code and Cursor. It includes an MCP server to facilitate browser-based OAuth authentication for secure data access.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across multiple protocols including Pay Link and x402. It is built to the agentskills.io standard, ensuring compatibility with OpenClaw and Hermes Agent for programmatic financial transactions.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill actually works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It facilitates a decentralized marketplace where humans approve winning answers and payments are distributed automatically via x402.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills to Hermes Agent via a hosted MCP server. It enables agents to access structured web data across 31 different platforms to support complex automated tasks.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured analysis featuring core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from major providers like OpenAI and Google. It serves as a specialized distribution layer for users who require reproducible development environments and automated package maintenance.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI interaction by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for mobile agent operations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. The setup supports shell command execution and interactive model configuration through both external providers and local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on cloud-native state safety. It enforces single-writer access for persistent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready CRD workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on high-security deployments by implementing hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing for granular security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and monitor Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative configuration of Hermes Agent deployments, including workspace documents and CLI settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure handling of secrets via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ acts as a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. The platform supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for headless operation, enabling the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from external drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework organizes specialized agents into a multi-tier structure of researchers, traders, and portfolio managers for financial analysis. It enables backtesting across various LLM providers and data vendors to evaluate fundamental, sentiment, and technical trading strategies.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a centralized Web UI or CLI. It supports multi-agent workflows with integrated memory browsing and can be deployed locally via Node.js or Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution and Docker for sandboxed environments. Users can monitor agent activity and review code diffs through both TUI and web-based dashboards.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain while supporting the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It features specialized detection for HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid API services.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for infrastructure tasks such as security auditing, VPS provisioning, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework facilitates the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to manage agent team delegation and integrates with MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface provides a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent tasks. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual approval for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure domains. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and a real-time Web UI. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols to handle local tools and communication throughout the automated task lifecycle.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent, referencing Arxiv research for its methodology. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while tracking candidate mutations and frontier progress.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to track performance metrics and GitHub star growth. It utilizes Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize code and scoreboard data.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: Optimized for consumer GPUs, this fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It eliminates cloud dependencies by running parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered knowledge graph that pre-indexes code to minimize token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It includes an MCP server and automatically synchronizes the index on every file change to ensure data remains current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool and 3D visualization dashboard designed to track token consumption and costs across multiple platforms, including Hermes Agent. It monitors local session files, databases, and transcripts to provide a comprehensive view of AI usage.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating detailed analysis of agent interactions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget tracks live token usage, costs, and rate limits for over 38 tools by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports real-time synchronization across multiple machines and provides historical breakdowns by model and session.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents, such as CTO and Builder, to manage the full application lifecycle with Hermes Agent. It features 36 skills for deployment and monitoring, operating autonomously while requiring human approval for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. The tool enables modification of banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art to personalize the CLI experience.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This project establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like LangGraph and CrewAI using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It extends these memory capabilities to chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and research, supported by an automated cross-platform installer.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter validates AI agent configurations and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring to detect ambiguous tools and contract mismatches. It operates locally without LLM calls or telemetry, supporting Markdown, JSON, YAML, and specific Python patterns.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents with local configurations and skills. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and handles nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It utilizes zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local monetization, this project operates as a deterministic zero-network runtime that requires explicit approval for all consequential actions. It includes specific contracts for managing opportunities, offer-previews, and exact-approvals.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in functionality without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent information. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for MemOS API outages and provides dedicated tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one interface for managing configurations across multiple agentic tools and CLI interfaces, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that enables autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access for agents like Hermes and Claude Code. It distinguishes itself by providing remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This tool provides parity with the Hermes CLI experience through a web browser using a three-panel layout and a workspace file browser. It is built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, intentionally avoiding build steps or frameworks for simplicity.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the initial experience with guided installation and provider setup for Hermes Agent. It features a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio is a web dashboard that supports multiple runtimes and offers unified configuration for ten communication platforms, including WhatsApp and Matrix. It features a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling and approval gates for complex task management.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for advanced task handling. It includes an integrated memory browser, an MCP catalog, and a full workspace file browser equipped with a Monaco editor and PTY terminal.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents and supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration. It offers high flexibility by running as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container, complemented by native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering alongside dedicated UI for chat and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes runtime directly to the active browser context. It features intelligent tab scoping and multi-agent thread synchronization, with opt-in controls for leased tabs and document access.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive a self-hosted agent from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and provides mobile management for server workspaces and scheduled tasks.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth, git projects, and cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes within a terminal environment.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It tracks per-session token burn and estimated API costs using a local search index that does not upload telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports task management through a kanban board and allows users to manage profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile-first dashboard runs locally as a Telegram Mini App with support for five concurrent background agent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application requires no installation or admin rights, running via self-contained Python and Node.js environments. It includes 100 tools for tasks like music generation and ComfyUI image creation, supported by a built-in workflow engine.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes a task tracking dashboard and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and API costs. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a native interface for model switching and streaming chat.
